title: adctowritesf64~
description: `adctowritesf64~` records between 1 and 64 ADC channels to a sound file, with controls for the file name, bytes per sample, and starting or stopping the recording session. The `ch_permutation` and `gain` lists can select, reorder, and scale the ADC inputs assigned to the recorded channels; it requires `prvu~.pd`.
